structure.layout: single full-viewport (1440x900, no scroll) game title screen: full-bleed WebGL canvas of a voxel battlefield scene with two officers, logo and 'press any key' prompt overlaid on the left third; main menu and controls panel exist in the DOM but are hidden until a key is pressed

aesthetics.typography: Xingkai SC (brush calligraphy) for the 250px 無雙 logo and h2 headings; Kaiti SC for Chinese menu labels, the 按任意鍵開始 prompt and name plates; Avenir Next, heavily letter-spaced uppercase, for English captions (VOXEL MUSOU, PRESS ANY KEY, ENTER keycap, Zhao Yun)
aesthetics.typeScale: Extreme contrast: 250px bold calligraphic logo vs ~50px prompt characters vs 16–19px tracked-out English captions; bilingual pairs with Chinese large and English small beneath

notes: Title/attract screen of a browser voxel 'Three Kingdoms Musou' game. Left-to-right dark vignette over a live WebGL canvas so the gold logo and cream text read cleanly. Gold-gradient brush calligraphy logo with a small red hanko-style seal (三國) and a red seal next to each officer's vertical Chinese name plate, plus a small dark tag with the romanized name. The ENTER keycap is a thin-outlined chip inline with the tracked-out 'PRESS ANY KEY'. Everything is bilingual (Traditional Chinese first, English small caps second). Hidden in the capture: a 4-item main menu, a bilingual controls table (keyboard + gamepad glyphs ×□△○), and a footer hint bar (↑↓ Select / Enter Confirm). Live, a second keypress opens a chapter-select screen with a detail panel. The page title is '趙雲 — Voxel Musou'.
